title: cedrus deodara var. robusta
intro: Cedrus deodara var. robusta, commonly known as Himalayan Cedar or Deodar Cedar, is a variant of the Deodar tree, native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues due to its health benefits in treating bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Cedrus deodara var. robusta include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and other organic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
